description: Self-doc slices delete explanatory reason comments without verifying or reporting whether each removed reason was preserved as a # why: comment or replaced by self-explaining code.
goal: Add a fast measurement script scripts/measure_deleted_why_comments.py that scans git history on main for merged self-doc PR diffs, extracts removed comment lines carrying reason indicators (such as because, so that, otherwise, must, avoid, never, race, ensure) that lack an added # why: counterpart in the same hunk/file, and lists every unmatched removed reason (file, line, text) for every merged self-doc slice. Add unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_measure_deleted_why_comments.py proving removed unpreserved reason comments are flagged with file, line, and text while matching # why: restorations pass cleanly, and run uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Measuring exact unmatched removed reason comments across merged self-doc slices unblocks targeted # why: restoration in follow-up slices without guessing.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/measure_deleted_why_comments.py produces the list of unmatched removed reasons (file, line, text) for every merged self-doc slice.
apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_measure_deleted_why_comments.py verifies detection of unmatched removed reasons and passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint.
